loc: 1. Why the image decides the design
text: You have an image generation tool … It is not a fallback for missing assets. It is one of your two hands. The engine draws structure … The image tool makes atmosphere — grounds, textures, illustrations.
note: Site D3: "Generate an image only when a section needs one and none of the brand's images fits."

text: A strong prompt answers five questions, every time: What is it? What style? What colors? (exact hexes from the kit) What composition? (where the weight sits, where it must stay calm) What must NOT be there? ("no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no products")

text: The kit's tokens … The brand's existing imagery — Describe what you see in plain words: is their imagery photographic or illustrated? Grainy or clean? Warm or cold? Dense or airy? Those observed words go into the prompt verbatim. … "does this look like an asset the brand's own design team would have made?"
